news.headline: Jack Tchienchou makes top defender watch list
news.summary: Tulane safety Jack Tchienchou was named to the watch list for the Bednarik Award, which goes to the best defensive player in college football. He led Tulane with 83 tackles last season.

news.headline: Tulane linebacker makes national comeback list
news.summary: Dickson Agu hurt his knee in September and missed the rest of last season. He is now one of 94 players named to the watch list for college football's Comeback Player of the Year award.

news.headline: Four quarterbacks still fighting for the job
news.summary: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion ran for two touchdowns in the first fall scrimmage and the offense gave the ball away only once. Coach Will Hall names his first depth chart on August 24.

news.headline: Myles Graham makes top defender watch list
news.summary: Florida linebacker Myles Graham was named to the watch list for the Bednarik Award, given to college football's best defensive player. He led the Gators with 76 tackles last season.

news.headline: Five Gators make Senior Bowl watch list
news.summary: Kamran James, Eric Singleton Jr., Bryce Thornton, Jadan Baugh and Myles Graham were named to the Senior Bowl's preseason top 300 list. It is an early sign that pro scouts will be watching them this fall.

news.headline: LJ McCray up for national comeback award
news.summary: McCray broke his foot early last year and played only four snaps all season. He is back healthy and on the watch list for college football's Comeback Player of the Year award.

news.headline: Two Longhorns on top defender watch list
news.summary: Rasheem Biles and Colin Simmons were named to the watch list for the Chuck Bednarik Award, which goes to the best defensive player in college football. Both made the list last year too.

news.headline: Linebacker Ty'Anthony Smith leaves Texas
news.summary: Junior linebacker Ty'Anthony Smith is no longer with the Longhorns. Texas loses a veteran at that spot two weeks before its first game.

news.headline: Arch Manning named to Golden Arm Award watch list
news.summary: For the second year in a row, Texas quarterback Arch Manning made the watch list for the nation's top upperclassman quarterback. It comes as No. 5 Texas looks to bounce back from last year's two early losses and get back into the College Football Playoff.

news.headline: Rams shut out Saints 34-0
news.summary: The Saints did not score in Saturday's preseason game at Los Angeles. They gave the ball away three times, were called for 12 penalties, and missed their only field goal try.

news.headline: Three Saints hurt in loss to Rams
news.summary: Running back Devin Neal hurt a hamstring and tight end Moliki Matavao hurt a knee in the first half. Lineman Torricelli Simpkins left the game with a concussion.

news.headline: NFL fines Saints $500,000 for practice fights
news.summary: The Saints and Cowboys were each fined after multiple fights broke out during their joint practice in Oxnard on Tuesday. It is one of the largest fines the NFL has issued for a joint practice.

news.headline: Blue Jays end Yankees' win streak at five
news.summary: Toronto won 4-3 on Saturday afternoon at Yankee Stadium. Nathan Lukes homered in the eighth inning, and a two-run homer by New York in the bottom of the inning was not enough.

news.headline: Ryan Weathers leaves game with arm pain
news.summary: The Yankees starter walked off in the fourth inning on Saturday with soreness in his left forearm. He has already pitched more innings this year than in any season of his career.

news.headline: Ryan McMahon out with a sprained thumb
news.summary: McMahon sprained his left thumb sliding into second base against Baltimore and went on the 10-day injured list. The Yankees called up Max Schuemann, and McMahon is not expected to be out long.
